title: Disjoint lifted frequency parts
statement: Let $J$ and $U$ be subsets of the coordinate set $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The frequencies in $U$ that lie in $J$, lifted to the full coordinate set, are disjoint from the frequencies in $U$ outside $J$, lifted to the full coordinate set.
